text: 中共中央政治局委员、中央财办主任何立峰14日在京会见美国桥水投资公司创始人达利欧。
text_en: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission, met with Ray Dalio, founder of US investment firm Bridgewater Associates, in Beijing on the 14th.
